free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed RNG seed so repeated runs and the clean-checkout replay are deterministic (T6/D8)

free_parameters.name: backend_type
free_parameters.why: non-tflite backend so the TFLite CUDA-cleanup branch before the target is skipped

free_parameters.name: backend_target
free_parameters.why: CPU-only machine; this value is not consulted before the target decision

free_parameters.name: backend_optmax
free_parameters.why: neutral backend option; only read after the target branch has been decided

free_parameters.name: cmp_with
free_parameters.why: no comparison backend; only read if backend_type were tflite, which it is not

free_parameters.name: filter_type
free_parameters.why: unknown filter name makes __init__ stop deterministically after the target decision with a ValueError instead of initialising a backend

free_parameters.name: filter_patch
free_parameters.why: no filter patch files; avoids filesystem access after the target

execution.entry_reason: The upstream call chain is inconsistent for this finding: call_chain[0] is PracticalHybridSearch.search_one, which has no call edge to FuzzingLoop.__init__ (FuzzingLoop.run would indirectly materialise inputs, not the reverse). The target is therefore reached by constructing the target function's own class directly; no stand-ins are used.
